extraction.Name: Rose Cordier Setter
extraction.NOTES: Document is heavily handwritten and largely illegible; notarized May 21, 1929 in Sawyer County, Wisconsin before notary public; notary commission expires Aug. 7, 1932; allottee signed her own name (not an X mark); questions reference Rosebud Sioux allottee status, fee patent delivery, protest status, land sale/mortgage, health, and dependents, but answers are not legibly recoverable
